title: Learning piano or guitar
summary: Hall says knowing piano helps; he played a little guitar by ear but knows little piano.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Yeah, but it takes time, those things will come to you. Would you advise clarinet players, say that is for a jazz band, to study any other instrument, like you think it would be good if you learned a little bit about piano? Or would it help you?

Well, it's good, it's good if you do know something about piano. You know what I mean? Because a lot of times you wouldn't have to ask a guy what chord it is, you go to the piano and you can figure out yourself if you know it.
Did you ever play any other instrument much? Yeah, he used to play guitar.
But it was just from, I didn't know how to read with it, but I just go from here.
At least you can hear your harmonies on it. Yeah.
I don't know anything about a piano. You know, I know where A is because I've been tuned up to it. I play a little blues, that's only one key.
